name: rsa_broadcast
note: Verification certificate for a synthetic textbook-weak RSA broadcast instance (Boneh / Hastad low-exponent broadcast, e=3, three pairwise-coprime moduli). The moduli, exponent, ciphertexts, and plaintext are printed in this file so the test is reproducible. Recovered by Chinese Remainder Theorem plus an integer cube root. Known-answer only. Not an attack on a real key, a live server, TLS, or a padding oracle. Not a reading of an unknown script. Not a claim about Kryptos K4, Zodiac, Beale, McCormick, Voynich, or army message Nr. 86. Attack description: Dan Boneh, Twenty Years of Attacks on the RSA Cryptosystem, Notices of the AMS 46(2), 1999, section on low public exponent attacks / Hastad; https://crypto.stanford.edu/~dabo/papers/RSA-survey.pdf
